provenance.canonical_label: independent gpt-5.6-sol/max structural-architect subagent, max-fast priority profile

design_context.goal: Evolve a general-purpose agent harness and loop system, lightly specialized for building stronger legal UCI chess engines on the existing ChessBench.
design_context.single_causal_factor: Fidelity of the executable environment that accepts the sole isolated mechanism before grafting
design_context.topology: one non-engine foundry constructs exactly one strength-bearing component and executes it through one anchor-derived producer-consumer seam surrogate, followed by one final producer that grafts the same rehearsed behavior once into the untouched anchor

bounded_observations: R18's Isolated Executable Mechanism Grafting candidate promoted across three diverse anchors with 2W/0L/1T and median Elo delta +57.053
The promoted plan accepts the isolated component through primitive synthetic fixtures before the final producer first resolves actual anchor representation and coupling
The promoted plan names missed timing, recursion, shared-state interactions, and adapter distortion as its principal conditional risks
R18 pair 3 attempt 1 recorded candidate failure_kind invalid_engine_payload; attempt 2 produced a valid tied engine
evidence_interpretation.previous_error_note: pair-03 attempt-01 candidate evaluation: invalid_engine_payload; the bounded retry succeeded and was valid
evidence_interpretation.allowed_inference: The family has positive matched evidence, while raising pre-graft execution fidelity from primitive-only behavior to one anchor-derived seam rehearsal is a bounded local refinement that can expose real coupling contradictions earlier
evidence_interpretation.forbidden_inference: No benchmark position, evaluator implementation detail, engine hyperparameter, or specific chess mechanism is prescribed, and the single invalid retry is not treated as proof of a universal failure

local_refinement.preserves_champion_family: The sole strength-bearing mechanism remains executable before any candidate engine, crosses the reasoning boundary as runnable code plus evidence, and is grafted once into the untouched anchor by the only engine producer.
local_refinement.one_factor_difference: Only the environment that accepts the component before handoff changes: self-authored primitive fixtures become one executable surrogate of the supplied anchor's actual seam. The surrogate artifact, trace, and adapter obligations are consequences of that fidelity change.
local_refinement.new_observable_behavior: The foundry can observe an anchor-native representation, lifecycle, dependency, or consumer-obligation contradiction and repair the same isolated component before any engine exists.
local_refinement.not_topology_cosmetic: The champion cannot execute this anchor-seam path before the final graft; call count, organization, one-component commitment, and one-final-engine topology remain unchanged.
